terminals.name: neon-proxy
terminals.description: Local Postgres WebSocket tunnel only when DATABASE_URL is loopback. Hosted Neon skips this process.

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; export BETTER_AUTH_URL="${BETTER_AUTH_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"; export CORS_ORIGIN="${CORS_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3001}"; export VITE_SERVER_URL="${VITE_SERVER_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"; export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"; bash scripts/cloud-agent/use-product-database.sh bun run dev
terminals.description: Turborepo dev servers: web (http://localhost:3001), API server (http://localhost:3000), and Fumadocs (http://localhost:4000). App writes follow injected DATABASE_URL.
